stage: W1 early-realism fix round 2 (the last shape round before texturing)
judged_set: WorkFiles/guns/smg/review/early_realism_r2 (ROUGH LOOK; judged again after the pause)

items.reason: Charging handle a perfectly smooth sphere on a thin rod through a plain slot, no knurling, neck or real lever shape (a CG primitive)
items.checked_against: LEFT / RIGHT draw the knob as a circle dia 16.76, TOP its tip at Y 47.5; the sheet's 3/4 shows a smooth satin ball with a flatter crown on a short neck, the drawn bar + rear block behind it (the lever's outer arm); craft study 2.3: ball ~18 on a short round neck ~8 dia, ~6 long. The built knob was a full sphere whose inner pole sat 0.4 off the arm level: no neck showed
items.fix: R43: a turned knob: flattened ball (Y semi-axis 6.9) with a crown flat dia 7.0 (R 0.8 edge), an R 2.4 cove into a dia 8.0 stem standing 2.0 off the shoulder band, the dia 5.43 neck through the slot showing below it; dia, centre and tip kept (LEFT / TOP). Not done: knurling (the sheet draws a smooth knob; nothing to copy); the slot and the arm are the drawn channel and lever (RP3)

items.reason: Stepped diagonal / polygonal / V-zigzag panel lines on the receiver side read as decorative sci-fi paneling, not a real upper / lower split or a moulding parting line
items.checked_against: LEFT and RIGHT draw every one of these lines (the horizontal run, the lower's front tab, the V tongue, the magwell front face: smg_geom.SEAM_PX; L3 measures features along them); the sheet draws them as moulded steps with a light edge and a shadow, not as engraved lines on one plane; real two-piece polymer receivers (an upper shell over a narrower trigger housing) show the split as a step
items.fix: R43: the trigger housing is set in 0.8 per side under the upper, so the whole drawn split is a real step (the upper's edge proud over the housing); side / top silhouettes unchanged (the upper is the wider moulding, the end block keeps its spec width); pin heads below the seam seat on the set-in face

items.reason: Front-end vent slots and the rail acceptable; rail teeth believable
items.fix: none

items.reason: A second round disc with a screw behind / above and partly under the selector lever, overlapping the seam: a duplicated or orphan part, a floating plate half-covering the selector
items.checked_against: LEFT draws the round boss behind and above the selector hub where the seam crosses, its pin, the hub partly over it (spec lower_receiver.features seam_boss; L3 'seam boss centre'); the built boss was a separate disc 0.2 lower than the seat (0.8 vs 1.0 proud), overlapping it by 3.5 mm, so it read as a second loose disc under the lever
items.fix: R43: the seat and the boss are ONE moulded pad (two circles joined by R 3.0 waist fillets, one height: 1.0 over the upper's face, 1.8 over the set-in housing; 0.6 top round); the upper's lower edge pockets round it (0.22); the pin 1.8 deep in the boss lobe. Both drawn circles stay (L3)

items.reason: No selector position markings (safe / semi / auto pictograms or letters) or detent / index marks on the receiver; the lever carries only an abstract circle-and-slash icon
items.checked_against: the brief: generic names only, NO markings on this asset; the sheet's only mark there is a small red paint dot left of the selector (paint, a W3 texture decision); the lever's 'icon' is the drawn index groove across the hub and the shaft-end ring
items.fix: none in geometry (no invented engraving); W3 decides the paint dot within the no-markings rule

items.reason: The pin heads around the selector randomly scattered
items.checked_against: every head is at its drawn position (spec pins_fasteners from the LEFT / RIGHT traces; L3 fastener heads within 2 sheet px)
items.fix: none (invent nothing / remove nothing the sheet draws)

items.reason: Where the grip back strap meets the stock mount the outline is lumpy and faceted, polygonal steps along the top right (low-poly, unfinished)
items.checked_against: the sheet draws one smooth concave sweep from the end block's bottom down into the back strap; fair_ring kept three 20-25 deg corner clusters between long flats (X 269 / 285 / 292) and the full-width tang showed each as a crease
items.fix: R43 MASTER_CURVES: the run X 253 .. 294.9 re-smoothed (Gaussian sigma 3.0, ends held, 1.0 mm chords, max turn per chord 1.8 deg); deviation from the faired outline <= 0.5 mm

items.reason: The trigger guard a thin octagonal loop of uniform section; its front end butts the mag release / magwell side with a visible gap or step (stamped and pasted on); its rear runs into the grip front as a thin bar with no web or blend
items.checked_against: LEFT draws the opening with 45 deg chamfered corners and the bar's side thickness (L2 per part trigger_guard: contour max <= 2 px); spec trigger_guard inner_corner_R 6-8 (the corners were built crisp); the gap in front of the leg is the mag release paddle's slot (spec trigger_guard.paddle_clevis, visible in both side views; the HK-pattern paddle release sits exactly there); the bar's Y width 10.9 is the spec's real norm (no view draws wider)
items.fix: R43: the opening's corners at the spec's R 6 (arcs on each chamfer), the outline's guard corners and the bar / grip notch smoothed (sigma 1.5-2.0), the rear bar flaring into the grip's front strap (half width 9.0 -> 5.45, below Z -74). Kept: the paddle slot (functional, drawn), the bar thickness (sheet)

items.reason: The grip has an arbitrary straight seam across its side
items.checked_against: it is the top border of the drawn stippled panel (LEFT / RIGHT draw the panel; spec pistol_grip.stipple_panel, 0.55 step); the rough-look material shows the border without the stipple
items.fix: none (W3 textures the stipple inside the border)

items.reason: The lower front rail hangs off a sloped wedge 'awning' block jutting under the receiver nose over the mag well; cantilevered on a separate plate with an angled hanger (a floating shelf glued on)
items.checked_against: LEFT draws the lower rail under the fore-end bottom (Z -27.5) and the lower's 45 deg front face from the rail's end down to the magwell front (master outline 477.5 / -32.9 -> 462.8 / -46.1; L2 / L3); the full-width housing then hung 10.5 mm per side over the narrower well (R31) as a flat shelf, which is what made it read stacked
items.fix: R43: the housing zone cut by a 35 deg funnel through its set-in faces at Z -49.6, with a skirt beside the well, so the well flares out of the housing as one moulding; the drawn front face and the rail kept

items.reason: The mag-well collar a separate stacked block with a lip under another shelf (stacked boxes, not one flared polymer well)
items.checked_against: the flare lip is drawn (LEFT: the bulge to X 462.3 at Z -63; spec magwell flare 7.2-9.1 high); the 'shelf over it' was the housing's flat underside
items.fix: R43 funnel (above); the lip's 45 deg top chamfer (R42) kept

items.reason: Seen from below the rail teeth look like separate tabs under a flat spine, not cross-slots through a dovetail
items.checked_against: MIL-STD-1913 (gunlib.parts.rail_1913, the AR-01's rail): square 5.24 x 3.0 slots cut across the head on one body; seen from the side-below the continuous part is the rail body above the head, the 'tabs' are the head's teeth with their 45 deg flanks between the slots
items.fix: none (line standard; GunLib untouched, the AR-01 exports stay exact)

items.reason: The curved top of the stock arm visibly faceted: hard crease lines across the bend
items.checked_against: the sheet draws the top strut rising into the head in one smooth curve; fair_ring left corner clusters (X 209-211, 216-219: up to 23 deg in 2 mm) between long straight snaps
items.fix: R43 MASTER_CURVES: X 181 .. 233.7 re-smoothed (sigma 3.0, 1.0 mm chords, max turn 3.1 deg per chord); the head's top follows the same outline to X 245

items.reason: The hinge hub has a raised strip / step at the bend that looks arbitrary
items.checked_against: r1 left a 0.5 trough 1.6 long across the top (the head held 0.5 under the neck's end, then its own traced top), and the head's plan flare was 6 long (read as a block)
items.fix: R43: the head's top / bottom on the outline with a 0.5 ramp that crosses the neck's eased end once, off any vertex row (X 221.5-224, dip at the crossing <= 0.1); the plan flare 11 long

items.reason: The rectangular latch block on the receiver's right rear looks pasted onto the surface
items.checked_against: the block is the stock-side hinge leaf from the head's right face to the knuckle (real barrel hinge pattern, Q6), built as a plain box
items.fix: R43: its front end a 45 deg gusset rising off the head's face (material removed only: the fold sweep can only gain clearance), rounded with the head

items.reason: Radial shading streaks fan out from the hole on the receiver's flat front face (smoothing / n-gon)
items.checked_against: traced: the master outline's front edge above the barrel's flange zig-zags (563.1 / 15.6 -> 564.1 / 16.7 -> 563.8 / 20.9 -> back to 562.9 / 19.0 -> 562.3 / 19.6 .. 25.5): a 1 mm step back and a stack of near-parallel full-width prism strips, triangulated as fans round the eyelet; measured also: the face's weighted normals left corners up to 9.9 deg off the plane. The drawn face is one plane up to the top chamfer (spec front_face_X 563.3)
items.fix: R43 smg_geom.MASTER_POLYS: the face one plane (X 563.3) up to its own traced 11.7 deg top chamfer, meeting at Z 20.68 (the trace's 562.28 / 25.46 lies on that line within 0.03); smg_parts._flatten_planar: every large flat region shades with its plane normal (thin slivers lying on the plane join within 8 deg), boundary edges >= 10 deg sharp; the geometry is not moved. Checked in early_realism_r3/g6 (no streaks)

items.reason: An unexplained round through-hole in the upper corner of the front face, placed like a second bore
items.checked_against: the front sling eyelet the LEFT and 3/4 views draw there (spec upper_receiver feature front_sling_eyelet); with the streaks gone it reads as a socket in a flat face
items.fix: none

items.reason: The barrel stub comes straight out of a flat box face with no barrel nut, trunnion cap or front-end detail
items.checked_against: the drawn collar ring at the face is built (face flange dia 26.4 x 3.6 over the collar dia 22.5 seated in the counterbore; L2 per part barrel); the sheet's 3/4 shows that plain collar, nothing more
items.fix: none (invent nothing)

items.reason: An A2 birdcage flash hider on a .45 blowback looks off; the stub and collar look thin for the bore
items.checked_against: the device is the sheet's own (LEFT / RIGHT / TOP / 3/4): a rear collar with a groove ring, a cage of six closed through-slots and a solid front rim (not an open-tined A2 birdcage); the neck dia 20.4 on the 11.4 bore leaves a 4.5 wall, a normal .45 SMG barrel
items.fix: none

items.reason: The front flip sight and the side vent slots acceptable
